description:
Welcome to Behind The Walls, where professional home inspection meets practical DIY knowledge.

I'm John Laforme, a Certified Professional Home Inspector helping homeowners, home buyers, and DIY enthusiasts make smarter decisions. This channel combines professional home inspection expertise with practical home maintenance and DIY advice you can trust.

You'll find videos on home inspections, DIY repairs, home improvement, plumbing, electrical, roofing, HVAC, moisture and mold, swimming pools, product reviews, installation tutorials, home maintenance, and first-time home buyer tips.

Every video is based on real-world experience from thousands of home inspections, giving you honest, easy-to-understand information to help identify problems, avoid costly repairs, and better understand how your home works.

Subscribe and discover what's really Behind The Walls. #AvantLink
